results.content: This paper is cited as a key related work that also tackles the KV cache bottleneck. KIVI's authors reference FlexGen's use of 4-bit group-wise quantization for both key and value caches, positioning their own asymmetric quantization strategy as a more nuanced and effective approach for lower bit-rates. [...] This paper's findings are fundamental to the core hypothesis of KIVI. The authors of KIVI explicitly state that their observation of persistent, large-magnitude outliers in fixed channels of the key cache aligns with previous findings in the AWQ paper, providing a critical justification for their decision to quantize the key cache per-channel. [...] This paper, which introduces the vLLM system and PagedAttention, represents a state-of-the-art, system-level approach to managing the KV cache memory bottleneck. KIVI positions itself as an orthogonal, algorithmic approach and uses the vLLM evaluation methodology to benchmark its own throughput and efficiency gains, demonstrating its relevance and competitiveness.

## Contributing [...] KIVI is a new plug-and-play 2bit KV cache quantization algorithm without any fine-tuning. This algorithm optimizes memory usage by quantizing the key cache per-channel and the value cache per-token to 2bit. KIVI's hardware-friendly design allows LLMs like Llama-2, Falcon, and Mistral to maintain comparable quality levels while reducing peak memory usage by 2.6 times. This enables up to 4 times larger batch sizes and significantly increases throughput by 2.35 to 3.47 times in real LLM inference [...] real LLM inference workloads, effectively addressing the bottleneck issues in speed and memory usage.

results.title: KIVI: A Tuning-Free Asymmetric 2bit Quantization for KV Cache [Quick Review]
results.content:
Efficiently serving large language models necessitates batching many requests, yet increased batch sizes and context lengths make KV cache a significant memory and speed bottleneck.
 Quantization can reduce KV cache size, but a lack of in-depth studies exists on its element distribution, hindering effective quantization strategies.
 This research aims to analyze KV cache element distribution in LLMs to identify optimal quantization approaches and overcome current limitations. [...] KIVI quantizes key cache per-channel and value cache per-token based on extensive analysis of outlier patterns and quantization error in KV cache.
 KIVI is a plug-and-play 2-bit KV cache quantization algorithm with hardware-friendly implementation that does not require fine-tuning.
 KIVI incorporates a grouped key cache and a residual key cache, maintaining the residual portion in full precision to handle streaming data and ensure accuracy. [...] Quick review

results.content: KIVI's own throughput and memory experiments were run on a single NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU, per the paper. That's the same GPU class you'd provision to reproduce these numbers directly, since matching the paper's hardware means matching its memory bandwidth and capacity ceiling rather than approximating it on a different card. Whatever headroom KIVI frees up in the KV cache translates directly into either a longer context window per sequence or more concurrent sequences in the same batch: the two [...] same batch: the two things KV cache capacity always trades against each other. [...] Weigh that against vLLM's own FP8 numbers from earlier: 1-2 points of degradation on reasoning tasks at roughly 54% of baseline memory, with zero setup cost beyond a flag. KIVI buys a much smaller footprint (2-bit vs 8-bit) at a comparable or slightly worse accuracy cost on reasoning-heavy tasks, plus the operational cost of leaving vLLM's engine entirely.
